notes.title: New Demo Update is Live!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]
We’re thrilled to roll out a brand-new demo patch. Thanks to your feedback, we’ve made the game smoother, clearer, and far less buggy. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Build System Stabilized[/b]
A major overhaul eliminates the build errors seen in Partition mode. Constructing structures is now rock-solid and hassle-free.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Collection System Completely Reworked[/b]
The old trigger-based setup sometimes forced unwanted machine interactions and wrong item pickups. An all-new [b]Line Trace-based[/b] collection system now ensures you gather exactly what you intend.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Camera System Rebuilt[/b]
Camera glitches during machine interactions are gone. Powered by the new Line Trace foundation, dynamic camera transitions are now smoother![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219839/abc0eea97050105f5f2bb711606dd33fcf9fbcfe.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Clearer Pickup Guidance[/b]
No more guesswork when grabbing items off the ground. Tooltips now show which weapon or tool collects each material—debris, minerals, scan objects, and more.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Machine Status Indicator[/b]
Approach a machine to instantly see its type and whether it’s running, making production management more comfortable.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219839/bfa97549435495559c74238e5242f6ba77c604a8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Whats to come in the next patch:[/b][/p][p][b]Custom Names for All Machines & Storage[/b]
In the upcoming update you’ll be able to assign a unique name to every usable machine and storage container.[/p][p][b]Line-Trace Storage Peek[/b]
When you point at a storage unit, the line-trace highlight will show its custom name and let you know what’s inside—no need to open the inventory.[/p][p][b]Remote Machine Control by Name[/b]
The control panel will list all your named machines. Thanks to those specific labels, you can instantly pick the exact unit you want and start or stop it remotely—no more running across.[/p][p][/p][p]After playing, please share your thoughts—we’re eager to keep improving![/p][p][/p][p]Happy building and have fun![/p]

notes.title: Update is on The Way!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]Thank you so much for checking out the Horizon Journey demo and for sharing your honest feedback at the Steam Next Fest. We've heard you loud and clear and we completely understand your frustration.[/p][p]Yes, this version of the demo was missing some absolutely critical features, and we take full responsibility for that. We released it too soon, and it showed. But we’re not leaving it like this.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What Went Wrong?[/b][/p][list][*][p]No settings menu. No mouse sensitivity adjustment. No key remapping. Unacceptable even in a demo.[/p][/*][*][p]No tutorial. No control hints. No onboarding experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Very dark environments with no way to adjust brightness.[/p][/*][*][p]UI bugs, confusing systems, and a general lack of clarity.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]What’s Coming – Very Soon![/b][/p][p]We’re already working hard on a patch that will:[/p][list][*][p]Add a full settings menu (mouse sensitivity, key bindings, audio/video settings)[/p][/*][*][p]Add a basic tutorial and control reference[/p][/*][*][p]Improve lighting and UI functionality[/p][/*][*][p]Fix a number of early usability bugs[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This updated demo build will be released before the end of Steam Next Fest.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Thank You for the Honest Feedback[/b][/h3][p]We know this demo let you down and that’s on us. But your feedback has been invaluable. We're making these fixes right now and hope you’ll give the updated version a try once it’s live.[/p][p]Stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]The Horizon Journey Dev Team[/p]
